bioAdditions: Marguerite (on her licence 'Margaret') Forgione was born in Scranton about 1913, a daughter of Peter (Pietro) Forgione, an Italian-born shoemaker, and Elizabeth D'Ettore; she was one of at least nine children (S1, S4). A 26-year-old seamstress living with her family on Farr Street, she married Ralph A. Cognetti on 1 June 1940 (S1). In 1950 she was keeping house for Ralph and their four children (S2). She outlived Ralph by five years and was still living in Scranton in 2012, when she was named as a surviving sister in her sister Amelia Amori's obituary (S5); the FamilySearch tree gives her death as 30 May 2014 in Scranton, aged about 101 (S4).
